infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FleetCommand collects bus location during active assigned trips for passenger safety and depot operations.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: FleetCommand requires background location during active bus trips so the control room can monitor bus progress while your screen is locked.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow FleetCommand to track bus location during active trips.
